title: Kay's GeoHub
text:
Geospatial analytics supports decision making, design and planning by providing insights derived from geographically referenced data. This includes the use of data wrangling, spatial statistics and spatial data visualisation technique.
This website serves as an archive for assignments for the course ISSS626 Geospatial Analytics and Application, taken in August 2026.

title: 04: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
text: Using steps learned from hands-on exercise, I will be working on this in-class exercise.

title: 04: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
text:
2. Determining adaptive bandwidth

bw_CV <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1, #gwr is a function, ~1 because there is only one variable, and will need to replace GDPPC if want to use another variable, rather than just adding the other variable in
                data=hunan_sp, 
                approach='CV',
                adaptive=TRUE,
                kernel="bisquare",
                longlat=T)

Adaptive bandwidth: 62 CV score: 15515442343 
Adaptive bandwidth: 46 CV score: 14937956887 
Adaptive bandwidth: 36 CV score: 14408561608 
Adaptive bandwidth: 29 CV score: 14198527496 
Adaptive bandwidth: 26 CV score: 13898800611 
Adaptive bandwidth: 22 CV score: 13662299974 
Adaptive bandwidth: 22 CV score: 13662299974 



bw_AIC <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1, #gwr is a function, ~1 because there is only one variable, and will need to replace GDPPC if want to use another variable, rather than just adding the other variable in
                data=hunan_sp, 
                approach='AICc',
                adaptive=TRUE,
                kernel="bisquare",
                longlat=T)

Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 62 AICc value: 1923.156 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 46 AICc value: 1920.469 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 36 AICc value: 1917.324 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 29 AICc value: 1916.661 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 26 AICc value: 1914.897 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 22 AICc value: 1914.045 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 22 AICc value: 1914.045 



gwstat <- gwss(data = hunan_sp,
               vars ='GDPPC',
               bw = bw_AIC,
               kernel = 'bisquare', #needs to be the same as the calculation
               quantile = TRUE,
               adaptive = TRUE,
               longlat = T)


gwstat_df <- as.data.frame(gwstat$SDF) 


hunan_gstat <- cbind(hunan_sf, gwstat_df) #as there is no unique identifier for the join, need to be careful that the sequence was not changed previously

title: 04: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
text:
3. Plotting the Geovisualisation

tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = 'GDPPC_LM',
              style = 'quantile',
              n = 5,
              values = 'brewer.blues', # can change to reds, greens
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = 'Local Mean')) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_title('Distribution of geographically weighted mean') +
  tm_layout(legend.position = c('left', 'bottom'))
